title: Robotic Luminescence Titration Lab
description: A robot lab assistant manages a precision titration experiment where glowing reagents are dispensed from enchanted lanterns into glass hurricane candle holders serving as reaction vessels. The user must command the robot to mix exact volumes from multiple lanterns while obeying conservation of reagent mass, coupling pH and luminescence outputs, and using undo/redo to correct mistakes across a 12-step calibration sequence.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) implementing a chemistry lab titration simulation. Load Lantern.glb three times, tinted red, blue, and green via emissive materials, positioned on a back shelf as reagent dispensers each holding 100mL. Load GlassHurricaneCandleHolder.glb twice as transparent reaction vessels on the lab bench. Load robot.glb as a lab assistant between the shelf and bench. Camera: perspective at (0,3,6) looking at origin. Lighting: ambient 0.3 intensity plus a warm point light above the bench. Interaction flow (12 steps): 1) Click a lantern to select a reagent source. 2) Click a glass vessel to set the target. 3) Use a slider (HTML overlay, 1-50mL) to set dispense volume. 4) Click 'Dispense' button: robot animates (lerp position) from idle to lantern, then to vessel, pours reagent. The lantern's stored volume decreases and the vessel's fill level rises (scale a colored translucent cylinder inside the vessel). Conservation law: total mL across all lanterns and vessels always equals 300. 5-8) Repeat dispensing different reagents into vessels. When two reagents mix, compute a blended color and a simulated pH (weighted average mapped 1-14) shown on an HTML pH meter. Luminescence intensity of the vessel glow (point light inside) couples to both pH and total volume: intensity = volume * abs(pH - 7) / 100. 9) Provide Undo button that reverses the last dispense, restoring volumes and colors. 10) Provide Redo button. Maintain a history stack of up to 20 states. 11-12) User must match a target color and pH displayed on a card by combining reagents in vessel 2, using undo/redo to iterate. Show a 'Match Score' percentage comparing current vs target color (Euclidean RGB distance) and pH difference. Display all numeric readouts in an HTML overlay panel. Add OrbitControls for camera. Animate robot arm with simple rotation tweens during pour. Vessel liquid uses a MeshPhysicalMaterial with transmission 0.6 and the blended reagent color.
